params.name: category
params.description: Restrict the random selection to a single category.

items.docs:
Retrieve a single random Chuck Norris joke. Optionally constrain the
random selection to a specific category by passing the `category` query
parameter (must be one of the values returned by `/jokes/categories`).

params.name: id
params.description: Joke identifier as returned by other endpoints.

items.docs: Retrieve a single joke by its 22-character identifier.
